'''Vryyyr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He served as the leader of the [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] who resided in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]]. He made a living by taking off-world hunters into the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]] of Kashyyyk's [[Forest/Legends|forests]] to track down and kill dangerous creatures.
